messages:
oliver: FYI hit duplicated webhook deliveries from the JS onboarding sample when token rotation and 429 coincide. repro'd locally this morning.
tasha: oof. can you paste the repro steps and the snippet?
oliver: steps: 1) run sample with short demo token 2) flood /chat calls to force auth refresh 3) some calls get 429, SDK retries after refresh and server processes same webhook twice.
jess: does the sample set an Idempotency-Key anywhere?
oliver: nope, intentionally minimal sample. call looks like: ```js
await client.chat.create({ messages }); // no idempotency header
```
ryan: two small changes for the sample: (A) show setting an Idempotency-Key on the operation and reusing it across retries, (B) add an opt-in replay header so older servers can dedupe.
tasha: agree. proposed headers: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` on initial send; on retries emit `x-rw-replay-id: <uuid>` and `x-rw-replay: 1`. server can use replay-id to correlate.
jess: SDK ergonomics: expose `safeReplayWindowMs` default 5000ms. if a non-idempotent op is retried after that window, don't replay silently — surface an error to the caller.
oliver: also add `sdk.replay_attempt` telemetry (replay_id + reason enum like AUTH_REFRESH_429). no payloads.
ryan: tests: add an integration test that simulates token expiry mid-flight and asserts only one webhook accepted. unit test for header emission.
tasha: sample README: short note "Without Idempotency-Key, 429+token refresh can cause duplicate side-effects. Use Idempotency-Key or enable replay headers for server-side dedupe."
infra-bot: Created issue #3620: onboarding sample - add idempotency + replay headers (oliver)
jess: can we also log a short correlation id in SDK logs when retrying so customers can give us that to triage? e.g., log `replay_id=... reason=auth_refresh`.
oliver: will include that. I'll open the PR with tests + docs after lunch. ping me for review.
ryan: nice. small fix but should reduce support tickets.
tasha: follow-up: write a KB article for partners that can't change their webhook ingestion — show server-side dedupe pseudo code using replay-id.
oliver: on the backlog. thanks all.
